question: Under what temporal condition is old age and death said to be destroyed?
premises: A duration of one year is given.
A condition of having been practiced is stated.
Old age and death are said to be destroyed.
inference: When this has been practiced for one year, old age and death are destroyed.
uncertainties: The subject of practice is not named in this verse.
plain_english: When practiced for one year, old age and death are destroyed.
